name: manual_154b11
claim: When git diff --submodule=log reports a submodule as rewind, the checkout is older than the recorded gitlink; never commit it (it regresses the pin) and restore with git submodule update on that path

decisions.notes: 2026-10-25: PT main clone showed vendor/agentic-stack and vendor/ecc-tools modified; the log view showed rewinds of many upstream commits, not local work
